Results.ReviewText: This is a follow up to my previous review in which I complained that my grill was not heating up properly. Weber's customer service got in touch with me and explained the lack of heat might be due to a safety feature that limits the flow of propane if a possible leak is detected. Starting the burners too quickly after opening the flow of propane can trigger this safety feature. After testing our grill, I found that I had been igniting the grill too quickly. As I mentioned in my initial review, this is our fourth Weber grill over 30 years. It's working great and we're happy with our purchase.
Results.Title: Great grill, excellent customer service

Results.ReviewText:
The Spirit E-210 is a small two-burner grill. But it’s just the right size for one or two people. There’s a much older Genesis at the lake house for larger gatherings, but this one is just the right size for weekday burgers, chops or chicken for two. 

I was a little concerned when was researching my purchase, thinking two burners might not get hot enough for a good sear. But it is not a problem,  and the cast iron grates provide great grill marks, too.  

It was clearly engineered and built with the same attention to detail as its larger brethren. The drip pan and the drip tray are well designed to make everyday cleanup a cinch. Weber flavorizer bars are the standard for gas grilling with a minimum of flare ups. The stainless steel side tables are generously sized and can keep plates, thermometer and utensils close at hand. 

The only problem I’ve run into so far has been a raccoon who went in through the open back of the cabinet and managed to make a mess, absconding with the foil drip pan and its evidently tasty (to it) drippings. Removing the drip pan after cool down and storing it on top of the grates in between uses has since stymied the raccoon.

This grill will get a lot of use and, as with my other Weber Grills, both gas and charcoal which remain in service, I expect to prepare many years of meals with it.
Results.Title: Solid performer in a small grill

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill from Lowe’s. We were looking for a grill for 2-4 people that we could easily regulate the heat so food would not be burned. I have grilled salmon x 2, burgers and chicken. I like the sturdy grill pieces that make nice marks on the meat. It is easy to start, the temperature heats fast and is easy to regulate. We chose a black exterior vs stainless steel to decrease upkeep. The side shelves are stainless-look pretty but easily become souled. Would prefer a black surface that is easier to clean. Did not want an extra burner. Like the door on front to hide propane tank but needed directions to connect the tank to the weight gadget under grill. I’m still unsure what the difference is between direct and indirect heat in grill. Most expensive grill we have ever purchased but we feel it was a good purchase.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We understand your concern, and we are happy to tell you that this issue is not dangerous and can be easily cleaned away.

The material inside the lid is called carbonized grease, and it is a natural result of grilling. It can be scraped off and then cleaned away with soapy water.

Our Care team is here to help with more cleaning tips. Please look for our email outreach soon!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: We have a grill E210 that the inside of the top that is peeling   This is my boyfriend’s father’s grilled who passed away in 2020. He has fond memories of them having a cook out on the back deck swapping stories of when he was growing and moving around due to his father being in the military for over 20 years. Too bad this happen.
Results.Title: Warranty issue w lid

Results.ReviewText: I'm overall very pleased with this grill.  I love Weber quality.  It's small but the cooking space seems larger than expected.  The ignition is great, love the different levels of heat to choose from on the dials.  Great temp gage.  It heats up well and evenly.  The drip pan set up is very well done.  I have not used the gas tank gage yet, so I can' comment on that.  The only negative I have seen so far is that the gas tank sits directly on the ground.  It is not set on a shelf inside the door.  This is an issue when you want to move the grill.  It's on great wheels, but the tank prevents it from moving.  Some might view this as a safety feature to keep the grill stable.  I view it as an obstacle to moving.  Anyway, I'm still happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Great Grill, Overall

Results.ReviewText: Works great!  Good quality.  Really like the size of this grill for 2 people.  Easier to handle for the most part.  The hardest part is being able to lift a full LP tank onto the holder, due to the amount of space with a single door.  Much easier in a larger grill.  For everyday use for cooking, this is not an issue, of course.  The laminated card with suggestions of times and power to grill various things is right on.  Enjoying this grill!
Results.Title: Nice Weber grill for small space.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Very good quality, well built. Heats well and evenly. Ignition works well.
Results.Title: Best grill we’ve ever owned.
